title: Inverse dimension parameter tends to zero
statement: For each natural number $n$, define $\delta_n=1/n$ when $n\ge2$, and $\delta_n=1/2$ otherwise. As $n$ tends to infinity, $\delta_n$ tends to $0$ through positive values in $[0,1/2]$.
